newsitem.title: UK: Currency subdues UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Currency subdues UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was quiet mainly due to a lower sterling on Thursday.
Sellers marked up soymeal and rapemeal as sterling fell with high protein soymeal up around one to two stg a tonne.
However, brokers said buyers were not chasing the sellers.
"There is some business going on but it hand-to-mouth, with very little forward trade," one broker said.
Demand from compounders is low following the spell of cold weather at the start of the month.

"Farmers stocked up when the weather was bad, but it did not last and they are now using up their stock, so compounders are seeing very little demand,' said another broker. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
